_about: How It Works: the landing page and its chapters, in reading order. The site (src/components/how-it-works/chapters.ts), the share-card script (npm run og:how-it-works) and the link-preview Worker (workers/meta-injector) all read this one list. To add a chapter: add it here, build its page, run npm run og:how-it-works. test/pipeline/how-it-works-share.test.ts fails until its card exists. In share descriptions, {concerts} and {years} are filled in from concerts.json when a link is previewed.
